messages:
maria: Need a tiny doc snippet for Dedicated elasticity: show autoscale policy + isolation label + fallback routing. One short YAML + one CLI line.

nick: I'll draft a compact example.

nick: ```yaml
# burst policy (elastic)
name: elasticity-burst
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 25
cpu_threshold_pct: 70
cooldown_seconds: 15
annotations:
  isolation: strict  # reserved pool, higher SLO
routing:
  fallback_model: "gptq-1.5b-quant"
```

nick: CLI to set label: `rwctl tenant set-label --tenant-id t-900 --label isolation=strict`

sung: Add short cost/SLA note: strict ~= 99.9% avail, cost ~ $0.10-0.20/hr/replica. Also migration tip: pre-warm replicas when switching isolation to avoid cold starts.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5120 (includes snippet + CLI + notes). reviewers: @maria @sung

maria: Thanks — I'll review after standup and add a link from the provisioning checklist.
